agent_explanation: Controller uses kp*velocity-error law without clamping to fmax after impulse-driven velocity jump. At step 28 bodies 0 and 1 are touching (gap 0.005), collision impulse at the substep boundary spikes body 0's velocity from ~2.9 to 10.27 m/s at step 29. The resulting force command 486.9 greatly exceeds fmax 72.67. Reducing intruder velocity prevents the spike and the violation, confirming collision impulse is the cause and controller does not enforce fmax post-collision.
